tagline: 禄来中画幅相机，1939 年发布
description: 禄来于1939年推出的中画幅相机。配备Carl Zeiss Tessar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm。快门速度Compur-Rapid CR00 leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.。使用12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm. Furthermore a Plate adapter for sheet film and a Rolleikin adapter for 35mm film cartridges can be used.。
